title: Peer test boundaries and faster qualification selection
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Compare current LibreDWG capability disclosures with its explicit test-coverage and version-fallback notes.
Reconcile ezdxf strict parsing, recovery/audit, owner binding, and ACIS payload authoring boundaries.
Refresh GDAL DXF binary input, geometry projection, 3D carrier, and writer-version boundaries.
Review the LibreDWG fuzz/regression workflow for a low-frequency security-checkpoint practice.
Refine existing implementation gates without new fixtures, dependencies, peer execution, or validation cadence.

sources.name: LibreDWG manual
sources.evidence: The approximate coverage headline coexists with explicit missing test-coverage entity/object lists and a note that some unhandled types remain opaque blobs without DXF codes.

sources.name: LibreDWG NEWS
sources.evidence: NEWS records the R2004 DWG writer addition and states that R2007 output falls back to R2010 rather than direct R2007 encoding.

sources.name: ezdxf loading design
sources.evidence: DXF loading separates raw structure/tag binding from section/layout construction and owner linking; the design also describes resource repair and orphan cleanup behavior.

sources.name: ezdxf recovery guide
sources.evidence: Recovery/audit is a separate route from ordinary strict loading and can produce repaired output.

sources.name: ezdxf ACIS entity authoring guide
sources.evidence: ACIS entity factory methods exist, but creation of required ACIS data is delegated to an external library.

sources.name: GDAL DXF driver documentation
sources.evidence: Binary DXF read support starts at GDAL 3.12; DXF output is AutoCAD 2004 and feature-based; AC1027+ 3D extensible mode exposes raw ASM plus transform, while default mode skips those modeler entities.

sources.name: LibreDWG AFL++ fuzz setup
sources.evidence: The setup separates route-specific fuzz targets, classifies crashes/hangs/leaks, and replays prior regressions through dedicated scripts.

method.limitations: Peer documentation is mutable and describes declared behavior, not runtime results for a pinned artifact. Recovery success, OGR projection, and opaque pass-through are not strict CAD-object or semantic support evidence.

localCrosswalk.PAR-07/S8: Keep strict independent DXF reopen separate from recovered/audited reopen; preserve input hashes and repair logs for diagnostic recovery; finish local generated profile-specific reference-remap tests before the existing composed independent-reopen gate.
localCrosswalk.DXF-writer: Key support by exact version, direction, family, strict/recovery mode, raw/projected representation, and observed output version. Do not use GDAL OGR output or optional unhandled-code fields as full-fidelity serializer evidence.
localCrosswalk.GDAL: Optional generated explicit-geometry projection and AC1027+ raw ASM/transform check only; record pinned version/options and source identity/disposition; Binary DXF route requires GDAL >=3.12.
localCrosswalk.security: Use peer fuzz methodology only at the existing composed hostile-input/security checkpoint; no peer fuzz or full-suite run per fast implementation slice.
localCrosswalk.compatibility: Preserve LibreCAD and LibreCAD_3 2D behavior while keeping optional 3D carrier and semantic claims distinct.
localCrosswalk.externalEvidence: J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
